group_only: This command only works inside a group.
bot_admin_needed: Make me a group admin first, then try again.
invite_reset:
Old link is now invalid.
New link: {url}
add_number:
Send the full number with country code.
Example: {prefix}add 919876543210
already_member: That person is already in the group.
add_privacy: Their privacy settings block adding. Share the group link instead: {prefix}grouplink
recently_left: They left this group recently and cannot be added right now.
target_needed:
Mention a person, reply to their message, or send their number.
Example: {prefix}{command} @person
not_member: That person is not in this group.
no_self_action: I will not do that to myself.
remove_rank: You cannot remove someone with the same or higher rank.
remove_owner: I will not remove the bot owner.
demote_rank: You cannot demote someone with the same or higher rank.
tagall_wait: {prefix}tagall is limited to protect the number. Try again in {minutes} min.
warn_target:
Mention a person or reply to their message.
Example: {prefix}warn @person spam
warn_removed: Limit reached: removed from the group.
warnings_private: Only admins can check other people. Use the command without a name to see yours.
unknown_member: I could not tell who that is.
resetwarn_target:
Mention a person or reply to their message.
Example: {prefix}resetwarn @person
warn_no_delete: I am not an admin here, so I can warn but not delete messages.
word_blocked: Blocked: "{word}". The word filter is ON for this group.
word_not_listed: That word was not in the list.
no_rules: No rules set yet. Admins can use {prefix}setrules <text>.
rules_input:
Write the rules after the command.
Example: {prefix}setrules 1. Be kind 2. No spam
rules_saved: Rules saved. Members can read them with {prefix}rules.
setting_unknown: Unknown setting "{setting}". Use {prefix}groupconfig to see the list.
setting_number: {setting} must be a whole number from {minimum} to {maximum}.
schedule_empty:
Nothing scheduled.
Example: {prefix}schedule 09:00 Good morning everyone
schedule_time_input:
Time must be 24 hour HH:MM.
Example: {prefix}schedule 09:00 Good morning
schedule_text_input: Add the message text after the time.
group_muted: Group muted. Only admins can send messages.
group_unmuted: Group unmuted. Everyone can send messages.
botadmin_target:
Mention the person or send their number.
Example: {prefix}botadmin add 919876543210
botadmin_not_found: They were not a bot admin.
antilink_note: Links from members are deleted and warned. Admins are exempt.
antispam_note: Repeated identical messages are deleted and warned.
antiflood_note: Very fast message bursts are warned.
settings_keys: Settings: warnlimit, warnaction (notify|kick), floodlimit, floodwindow, spamrepeat, spamwindow, welcomemsg, goodbyemsg
private_operator: Use the owner self-chat or your sudo private DM
reminder_expired: Run remind add again and review the exact reminder
reminder_limits: Use 1-1000 characters and a future time within 90 days
ttt_start:
You are X, Tab is O.
```
{board}
```
Reply with {prefix}ttt 1 through {prefix}ttt 9. Three-minute limit.
wordgame_start:
Letters: {letters}
Make English words of 3+ letters using each letter at most once.
{prefix}wordgame <word>
{prefix}wordgame end to finish. Three-minute limit. Uses a small curated dictionary.
wordgame_invalid: Not a supported word from these letters
update_restarting: Installed v{version}. Restarting only Tab now.
speedtest_full_unavailable: Full bandwidth test is not installed. Quick measures host HTTPS latency only, not download/upload Mbps.
speedtest_result:
Host HTTPS latency: {milliseconds} ms
Endpoint: Cloudflare
Includes DNS, TLS and response time. This is not your phone speed or a bandwidth test.
ops_errors: Repeated errors detected. Recent failures are recorded; no source code changed.
ops_ram: Shared host RAM stayed above 90% for three checks. No process was killed.
ops_disk: Tab files are near the configured quota. Only stale job folders were cleaned.
ops_reconnected: WhatsApp connection recovered after a sustained disconnect. Alerts cannot arrive while WhatsApp is disconnected.
ops_daily:
Daily self-check
WhatsApp: online
Bot RAM: {ram} MiB
ops_update_failed: Update v{version} failed health checks. Previous source restored.
game_expired: Game timed out. Start a new game.
choose_limits: Use 2-10 options separated by |, up to 120 characters each
moderation_words: that word is not allowed here
moderation_repeat: please do not repeat the same message
moderation_fast: you are sending messages too fast
sudo_added: Sudo user added with full command access. Sudo management stays primary-owner-only. Group admin checks still apply.
sudo_removed: Sudo user removed. New commands now use regular permissions.
prefix_help:
Current prefix: {prefix}

Change it: {prefix}setprefix <new prefix>
Examples: {prefix}setprefix !   {prefix}setprefix .   {prefix}setprefix 🤖
Reset: {prefix}setprefix reset
If you forget it, /setprefix reset always works.
prefix_length: Use a short prefix: 1 to 3 characters.
prefix_warning: Note: a letter or number prefix can match normal chat. Commands will look like {prefix}menu.
sudo_user: You are a sudo user with full command access.
usage_alias_suggestion: {prefix}{command} is used often. A short alias could help (suggestion only).
invalid_datetime: Use YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm and an optional IANA timezone
timezone_clock_change: Time falls in a timezone clock change
group_permission_owner: Only the bot owner can use this command.
group_permission_botadmin: Only bot admins can use this command.
group_permission_admin: Only group admins can use this command.
reminder_time_limit: Reminder must be in the next 90 days
moderation_toxic: that message looks abusive or hateful
